question.zh: 同一公共任务如何先由普通服务可靠完成，再判断 AI 是否带来可证明的增益？——机器人—行人—无障碍受控测试

space.zh: 众智园能力验证庭·围合测试环

ordinary_answer.zh: 以人工安全员、实体隔离、步行优先路线和手动急停完成小规模测试。
ordinary_answer.en: A safety steward, physical separation, pedestrian-priority route and manual emergency stop support the test.

ai_answer.zh: 可选低速机器人在限定时窗和限定速度内运行，实时记录近失误与人工接管。

minimum_data.zh: 匿名事件计数、速度、制动距离、接管时间、测试时窗。
minimum_data.en: Anonymous incident counts, speed, braking distance, takeover time and test window.

human_responsibility.zh: 现场安全主管拥有独立断电权；无障碍观察员共同复核。
human_responsibility.en: The site safety lead holds independent power-off authority with an accessibility observer.

admission_conditions.zh: 普通通路持续开放，隔离、急停、保险和人员培训完成。
admission_conditions.en: The ordinary answer for T2 is independently operational; accountable staff, minimum data and restoration route are verified.

stop_conditions.zh: 任何人进入安全缓冲区、连续两次近失误或急停失效即停止。
stop_conditions.en: Stop T2 when safety, rights, data minimisation, human takeover or reliable degradation fails; the human lead has final authority.

exit_and_restore.zh: 机器人撤库、临时围栏拆除；保留步行路径、座椅与事件公告位。

no_regression.zh: 普通服务的可达性、可靠性和公平性不得降低
no_regression.en: Accessibility, reliability and equity of the baseline may not regress

zero_tolerance.zh: 计数漂移、容量接近上限、出口受阻或任何安全事件时停止入场/AI。
zero_tolerance.en: Stop S9 when safety, rights, data minimisation, human takeover or reliable degradation fails; the human lead has final authority.

ai_increment_threshold.zh: 在 E2 基线完成后由人类场景委员会登记，当前为 unknown

maintenance_cycle.zh: 由复制场景运营者在 E2 前登记

zero_tolerance_events.en: Stop S9 when safety, rights, data minimisation, human takeover or reliable degradation fails; the human lead has final authority.

recovery_protocol.zh: 拆除计数插件，保留普通活动电源、容量牌和疏散设施。
recovery_protocol.en: Remove and isolate the optional S9 equipment; retain the complete staffed, static and accessible baseline.

measurement_clock.zh: 停止指令发出时开始，普通任务由人工完成且两条公共路线恢复开放时结束；E2 演练前不设虚构阈值。
measurement_clock.en: Starts at the stop command and ends when staff complete the ordinary task and both public routes reopen; no invented threshold before E2.

baseline_sample_rule.zh: 同题、同人、同空间、同时间分层；普通服务先记录，AI 只比较增量。
baseline_sample_rule.en: Same task, user, space and stratified time; baseline first, then compare only the AI increment.

recovery_verification.zh: 安全、普通服务和公众代表共同签字；结果只允许 adopt / revise / stop。
recovery_verification.en: Safety, baseline-service and public representatives co-sign; adopt / revise / stop only.

recovery_exit.zh: 拆除计数插件，保留普通活动电源、容量牌和疏散设施。
recovery_exit.en: Remove and isolate the optional S9 equipment; retain the complete staffed, static and accessible baseline.

threshold_rule.en: Baseline service may not regress; safety events have zero tolerance; the human scene committee registers any AI-increment threshold only after the baseline.

missing_data_rule.en: Missing samples are never deleted or imputed as success; publish the reason, and if stratified comparison is compromised the result can only be revise or stop.

human_review.zh: 普通服务负责人、数据负责人、安全负责人和公众代表共同复核，AI 不拥有决定权。
human_review.en: The baseline-service lead, data lead, safety lead and public representative review together; AI has no decision authority.
